001package io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.memory;
002
003import io.github.kale_ko.bjsl.processor.ObjectProcessor;
004import io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.UnstructuredConfig;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007
008/**
009 * An Unstructured Memory Config for storing data in memory
010 *
011 * @version 5.0.0
012 * @since 3.0.0
013 */
014public class UnstructuredMemoryConfig extends UnstructuredConfig {
015    /**
016     * Create a new UnstructuredMemoryConfig
017     *
018     * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
019     *
020     * @since 3.0.0
021     */
022    protected UnstructuredMemoryConfig(@NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
023        super(processor);
024    }
025
026    /**
027     * Get if the config is loaded
028     *
029     * @return If the config is loaded
030     *
031     * @since 1.0.0
032     */
033    @Override
034    public boolean getLoaded() {
035        return true;
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Load the config
040     *
041     * @param save Weather to save the config after loaded (To update the template)
042     *
043     * @throws IOException On load error
044     * @since 1.3.0
045     */
046    @Override
047    public void load(boolean save) throws IOException {
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * Save the config to memory
052     *
053     * @throws IOException On save error
054     * @since 1.0.0
055     */
056    @Override
057    public void save() throws IOException {
058    }
059
060    /**
061     * Close the config
062     *
063     * @throws IOException On close error
064     * @since 1.0.0
065     */
066    @Override
067    public void close() throws IOException {
068        this.config = null;
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Get if the config is closed
073     *
074     * @return If the config is closed
075     *
076     * @since 1.0.0
077     */
078    public boolean isClosed() {
079        return this.config == null;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * A builder class for creating new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.memory.UnstructuredMemoryConfig}s
084     *
085     * @version 5.0.0
086     * @since 4.0.0
087     */
088    public static class Builder {
089        /**
090         * The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
091         *
092         * @since 4.0.0
093         */
094        protected @NotNull ObjectProcessor processor;
095
096        /**
097         * Create an {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.memory.UnstructuredMemoryConfig} builder
098         *
099         * @since 4.0.0
100         */
101        public Builder() {
102            this.processor = new ObjectProcessor.Builder().build();
103        }
104
105        /**
106         * Get the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
107         *
108         * @return The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
109         *
110         * @since 4.0.0
111         */
112        public @NotNull ObjectProcessor getProcessor() {
113            return this.processor;
114        }
115
116        /**
117         * Set the ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
118         *
119         * @param processor The ObjectProcessor to use for serialization/deserialization
120         *
121         * @return Self for chaining
122         *
123         * @since 4.0.0
124         */
125        public @NotNull Builder setProcessor(@NotNull ObjectProcessor processor) {
126            this.processor = processor;
127            return this;
128        }
129
130
131        /**
132         * Creating a new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.memory.UnstructuredMemoryConfig}
133         *
134         * @return A new {@link io.github.kale_ko.ejcl.memory.UnstructuredMemoryConfig}
135         *
136         * @since 4.0.0
137         */
138        public @NotNull UnstructuredMemoryConfig build() {
139            return new UnstructuredMemoryConfig(this.processor);
140        }
141    }
142}
